status: Open candidate findings, not Google Fonts waivers

explanations.googlefonts/metadata/consistent_repo_url: 1.9.0 compares whitespace tokens containing github.com with the repository path, including href markup and the required designer profile. Retain credits; resolve with GF/tool maintainers.
explanations.googlefonts/tofu: Intentional GF Latin Core scope (#118): detected languages have sample-only U+0331, U+02BC or U+014B outside the 319-character contract. These are real missing characters, not fixed shaping or waived GF requirements. Curator decision remains open.
explanations.googlefonts/metadata/subsets_correct: Latin Core includes characters served by latin-ext despite under 20% coverage of that larger serving subset. Keep the declaration pending curator guidance.
